preconditions.description: n and q are within the specified range.
s_0 has a length between 1 and 100, and t has a length equal to n.

preconditions.expression: all('a' <= char <= 'z' for char in s_0 + t)
preconditions.description: All characters in s_0 and t are lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= k <= n for k in query_indices)
preconditions.description: Each query index k is within the range [0, n].

preconditions.expression: all(len(w) > 0 and all('a' <= char <= 'z' for char in w) for w in query_names)
preconditions.description: Each sailor's name w is a non-empty string of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of queries.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) and line.isdigit() for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is a string representing a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(int(line) % (10**9 + 7) == int(line) for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output value is within the range [0, 10^9+7).

postconditions.expression: all(count_occurrences(s_k, w) % (10**9 + 7) == int(output_lines[i]) for i, (k, w) in enumerate(zip(query_indices, query_names)))
postconditions.description: Each output line correctly represents the number of occurrences of w in s_k modulo 10^9+7.
